notes.title: The Summer Update!
notes.content:
Hello ghost hunters, it's hard to believe we're already in summer but that means it's time for the big summer update!

We've got some exciting new stuff to bring to your ghost hunting adventures with Bob and Susan:

-New art: 

We've commissioned new key art from the amazingly talented artist @marymoroz who was responsible for the ghost portraits in the game as well!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/a7e5bf83eaebd0d59f9f131b0e7be7868f77b6f7.png"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/c363adde20745b66ff25e8a9bfa9dcc6137b1854.png"]



-New map, the Gas Station:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/a5e28f463d219bb639ff82e909d9944d289c9a57.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/f785b5c9d109e8a176626f30bdbc07da7a32c4da.png"]Ready to see Bob get murdered by a ghost in a Gas Station surrounded by a middle-of-nowhere spooky forest? Us too!

-New minigame: Bob's Dungeon:

We've loved seeing people chill out with some minigames between missions, so we wanted to bring another one to you!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/9ce5c4cf9b95b1b77d37b03a99ed1cfd3ef4647d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/9205b50dccae4d4c788c23257fedd0c99fb1ce4c.png"]Meet Bob's Dungeon, a full-fledged dungeon management game where you are the dungeon, and have a choice: what kind of dungeon do you want to be? Do you try to murder every adventurer for sweet-sweet experience and essence, or do you lure more in with treasure and profit long-term? 

As usual, we love Twitch integrations, so beware streamers - be prepared for chatters to be able to make their own adventurers to try to destroy your dungeon core!

-Cloud saves:

 We've reworked our saves and persistence systems to support Steam cloud saves, for when you migrate to a new computer you won't lose all the cats you've rescued in the lobby.

-New voice recognition tech:

BITN's been migrated to a new voice recognition system which will be a significant improvement in accuracy and fuzzy-matching - still a work in progress with a few phrases to iron out but in general should be a large upgrade long-term.

But wait, there's more!
-Additions and QoL for the Lobby

-New spook events, including one that was a user suggestion that we developed live on stream! Shoutout to @ChelvieGaming on Twitch!

-Several lighting fixes across various maps

-Miscellaneous  bug fixes and QoL improvements across multiple maps

notes.title: Valentine's Day Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/c43216fa5491b03d0681f192d281f05636c16602.png

Happy Valentine's Day ghost hunters!

Love is in the air and you might notice some new decorations in the office around the holiday.

We've added some new scares, as well as some new behaviors for some of our favorite ghosts:

 Grimm's can now (rarely) choose the player as their obsession. How Yandere of them!
 Trasgo's might bring you gifts if you're lucky!


Stay tuned for more updates as we fine-tune our roadmap! Stay spooky <3

notes.title: The Winter Update is here!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone! We're pleased to announce the Winter Update, 'tis the season.

Without further ado, here's the meat and potatoes of the update - two new ghosts have arrived, the Morozko and the Skinwalker!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/67f319d7db42021be94f07fbfacce460481919e6.png

Introducing the Morozko, chilling!
"A spirit of frost from Slovic folklore that becomes extremely aggressive if the environment is cold enough - a prospect that is only a matter of time, as reports indicate that the Morozko freezes an area faster than any other ghost."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/2bb70fca5db4ea7703d1ad501ed45aa5721bcff1.jpg

Not to be mistaken for a Wendigo folks, here's the Skinwalker!
"A malevolent spirit from Native American legend, the Skinwalker is one of the most dangerous ghosts an investigator can encounter. Aggressive and cunning, rumors say that they can mimic behaviors typically reserved for other ghosts."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/ef6623e23362b737e6928bb85610af0d53bb4794.jpg

We're bringing some new features to the lobby, most notable of which is a new room you can unlock! What secrets could lie beyond? More importantly, how many more cats would the room hold?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/6dcf8879b627953dc6a66b16d7e288ff3eb4c87b.png

Also in this update: there's a plethora of new spooks to see which we'll let you discover yourself, as well as a slew of bug fixes and quality of life improvements.

Thank you everyone for your support! 
Join our discord here!

notes.title: Happy Halloween! Early access release and recent updates
notes.content:
Happy Halloween ghost hunters!

It's been a wild ride releasing on the 22nd and seeing a tide of new players get their hands on the retail game, experiencing the Theater Church and School maps for the first time. We appreciate everyone's support, streams and reviews - every bit helps us to make BITN the best it can be!

We've been hard at work since the 22nd to fix bugs, incorporate feedback and add more features, more ghostly shenanigans, and of course more cats for your office.

In other exciting news, we saw our first 5k+ stream of the game! Bob and Susan handled the flood of chat commands surprisingly well in Democracy mode, and as for the printer in the lobby, well...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/873998d4e13cdf41c41086650cd3409bccbb5914.png

Now that we've released BITN to early access, the road to full release begins! We're crafting a detailed roadmap for you all to check out but in general you can look forward to new events, new maps, more interactions with Bob and Susan, and more minigames on the lobby's PC!

Here's some of the updates we've put out in the past two weeks!

 Two new difficulty modes, Hell and Impossible
 Added more rescuable cats to the office, one of which is named after Chelvie our first player to beat Impossible difficulty! 
 Fix Twitch integration Democracy mode on the School map
 Fix Twitch integration Idle Democracy and Idle Anarchy modes, now working as intended
 Prevent Bob from wandering off too far off the beaten track around the Gym on the School map
 New command, !channel {1-4} {roomName}. Directly sets a CCTV to a room by name!
 Bob and Susan should move fully into the HQ when you ask them to come back, on the Theater map
 Ghosts can blow out the candles you purchase, not just the default one
 Added weather effects and events to the School map
 Added sound cues to one of our more stealthy lethal events to make it a little more detectable
 Ghost of a Chance minigame on your lobby's PC has had a massive update! New perks, new waves, balancing updates, health pickups and exp collection pickups that can now drop from enemies
 To prevent confusion, no longer auto-select NPCs when giving them an item
 "Gameplay" tab in Settings menu is now the "Integrations" tab, with twitch auth button moved to the top
 Fix issue on the Lobby PC where the video player was non-closeable
 Bob and Susan should move fully into the HQ when you ask them to come back, on the Theater map
 Fixed some spook events that should give photo credit that were not
 Entryway for the School map should now be a valid target for voice and Twitch commands
 Crosses should guarantee immunity against all lethal events now (once)
 Nerf the radius that candles and flashlight can destroy [Redacted]
 Reduce the distance at which flashlights and your camera should be impacted by wall collision
 Balanced some events that were happening too rarely or too often
 Theater is now the 2nd map in the map progression, School is now the 3rd
 Reduced item prices. Candles are now $25, salt and crosses are $50
 Item shop UI overhaul / quality of life improvements
 Add "come back" command
 Fix Ghost of a Chance minigame crash to desktop bug 
 Bathroom 1 and Bathroom 2 on Theater map should now properly recognize placed EMF being in them
 Fixed various place locations for items across the four maps


Thank you everyone for your support! We're working to make the game better and better daily and love seeing your reactions to everything!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/9cadefd312edab98fc12172b47b75f8d8d698493.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/ce1494c7f24ddde42ec5df5e2f3e3e594eac1429.png

Join our discord here!

notes.title: End of July Report
notes.content:
July has come and gone, and we wanted to share some of what we've been tinkering on during that time!

The school map is rapidly becoming one of our favorite haunts, here's a sneak peak:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/bacbdfbc60302a8287b7ecc21eff11cb8f560c2d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/b78e981b8b7a616aeb159555ffedaa0d28e5b7f8.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/38e648b0575bfdf7bd11e731316cfbb4a68148de.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/6be4e75c2b422f64a097d8a4897f75260c3699f1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/f5c49fcf7c3f4e0e7fd201b5b022743943ca644e.png

On another note - if you like Survivorlikes, we recommend trying out the "Ghost of a Chance" app now on your computer in the lobby!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/183b4f8ed353d71cf8f94c8a265c4a462f445f6d.png

We've made some balance and quality of life updates to the game as well. 

First off, we figured it's time to reward the players that keep Bob and Susan alive for a change. Hey, they're still expendable but you'll end with a little more cash if one or both of them survive.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/be90720e6a738d26fe6a6daf1da674c312224691.png

There's a new feedback form as well! We appreciate all thoughts and suggestions :)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/f90011e96d92fa5b2d200ac3b39cf75405dab4f8.png

Additional fixes and QoL updates include:

 Fixed a bug that can occur with screen resolution settings on first startup.
 Fixed placement of some evidence items (IE: EMF detector) in certain rooms.
 Fixed a bug where multiple subtitles would appear for one voice line.
 Limited Bob and Susan reacting to a photo taken of them to one reaction per photo.
 When ordering Bob or Susan to place an item in a room, if no item is equipped it will now default to the move command.


Thanks for your support! And remember to keep Bob alive ;)
#SadBob
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44882963/ce1494c7f24ddde42ec5df5e2f3e3e594eac1429.png

Join our discord here!

notes.title: End of March Updates
notes.content:
Greetings ghost hunters! Here's what we've been up to with the last few mini-patches:


 Added a few fun features to the Idle Game on the Lobby's PC.
 Fixed some controller support issues for the Lobby's PC apps.
 Fixed bugs with the flashlight / camera entering a stuck state.
 Twitch Integration and voice commands saw some additions and fixes. Should work more consistently now when commanding individual investigators such as "Bob move hallway" or "Susan place living room".
 Candle equipment is now tracked on the whiteboard as the other equipment items are.
 Trasgo's have been observed doing more [Redacted]
 Ectophages have a more interesting unique ability now
 Bob and Susan will now do their own spirit box sessions randomly if holding one, without needing explicit player permission all the time.
 New voice lines and interactivity for both Bob and Susan.
 The bedroom door now opens in the opposite direction, in response to feedback.
 CCTVs now show the room they're set to.
 Bob and Susan will give brief explanations of items given to them if you're in the middle of the tutorial.
 Fix the Failed Mission stat.
 More Spookz.
 Removed Chuckles.
